name: Omni Odax
description: It does not swing on instinct — it swings on the beat. Omni Odax reads the tempo of a fight and locks onto it, every landed strike setting the next one a fraction earlier. Fall into its rhythm and the drop comes before you have finished counting.

abilities.name: Sound of Battle
abilities.description:
Omni Odax keeps time with the fight. Every Attack win sets a **Beat**: **+7 Attack** that stays for the rest of the battle, up to **4**, and one beat banked for the drop.
**Blast Beat** spends every banked beat at once — **+15 damage each**, so a Special fired on a full bar lands **60** above its printed damage. The bank empties; the Attack the beats bought does not.

special_move.name: Blast Beat
special_move.description: Omni Odax's signature move. It synchronises with the rhythm of the battle itself and answers on the downbeat — three strikes on the count, and every beat banked so far lands with them.
flavour_texts: 🥁 **Blast Beat** — Omni Odax finds the tempo of the fight!
🎵 **Beat 2** — the strikes fall on the count!
💥 **BLAST BEAT** — the drop lands, and every banked beat with it!
